messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "keep in a safe place to protect from theft"
set: ["keep in a safe place to protect from theft", "keep in original carton until use to protect from light", "protect from light", "store in a safe place such as a locked cabinet", "store in safe place to prevent stealing or abuse", "protect skin from sun", "protect from heat and light", "store in a dry place", "store in dry place away from moisture", "protect from excessive heat and sunlight", "keep in a closed container", "keep your medicine in a place where no one can use it improperly", "keep away from heat and light", "keep in its original container protected from heat and light", "keep canister away from open flame or high heat, such as in a car on a hot day", "store tablets at room temperature, 68°F to 77°F (20°C to 25°C), and protect them from light"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
